answer: The inlet index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 650 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the forge. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the grove queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Slashing removes 84 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
